
---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_speed    = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_speed = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_speed   = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_speed    = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = speed,
    y = fct_rev(month),
    fill = month
  )) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.7,
    scale = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Speed Distributions by Month",
    subtitle = "GPS fixes with speeds above 30 m/s excluded",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
